title: Fouche: the TR3B uses internal mass reduction

tellings.quote: cuz fuch was adamant that the TR3B is not anti-gravity. It's internal mass reduction. It's to reduce the weight the mass of the TR3B by I think 89%.

plain: The TR3B, said to be a secret triangular US aircraft from the 1990s, does not use anti-gravity but "internal mass reduction," which supposedly cuts the craft's mass by about 89 percent. That was the view of a man named Edgar Fouche, who claimed inside knowledge of secret aircraft. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb passes this on, saying Fouche "was adamant" about it. If true, it would mean the US built a craft that works by making itself almost weightless.
